citations.title: About Flip: The Future of Voice AI Technology - Flip
excerpts:
Flip’s founders Brian Schiff and Sam Krut met at Cornell and built a ride-hailing app. That’s where they realized there was a bigger problem worth solving: the universal pain of calling customer service.
What began as a simple insight—that phone support needed a modern solution—is now a platform that helps hundreds of brands automate millions of calls every week.
No more endless menus. No more button presses. No more hold queues. No more robotic experiences. Just real support, automated the right way with Voice AI.
That’s why Flip was born – to flip phone customer support from a pain point to an awesome experience.
